coverage.landlord_size_condition: Applies to all landlords, including an owner of a single rental unit in the building where the owner lives
coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental agreements in Cambridge, including single dwelling units and tenancies at will. Excludes units in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, non-profit short-term substance-abuse treatment facilities, and Short Term Rental Units.
coverage.other_conditions: Excludes Short Term Rental Units under Cambridge Zoning Ordinance Art. 4, § 4.60, and rental units in hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, health facilities and non-profit short-term substance-abuse treatment facilities.

result.notes: supersedes_state_rule changed from false to null: no document says how this ordinance relates to any state rule. The FAQ statement that the ordinance does not prevent an eviction 'if otherwise allowed by law' concerns landlord conduct, not supersession.
